title: Impoverishment Of Peasantry
definition: The systematic economic ruin, destitution, and loss of land rights of the Indian agricultural population resulting from British colonial land revenue systems, commercialization of agriculture, and destruction of traditional village self-sufficiency.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Modern History (GS-1) covering the socio-economic impact of British rule, land revenue settlements (Permanent, Ryotwari, Mahalwari), peasant movements (Indigo, Deccan Riots, Moplah, Bardoli), and Mains analytical questions regarding the de-peasantization of India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Impoverishment Of Peasantry.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of British Expansion and Administration in India
